static_traits.name: 林苏菲
static_traits.educational_background: Currently in high school, received a scholarship for football
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk with, but rarely shares physique / self-image distress; reduces socializing to accommodate training, and friendships are affected
static_traits.medical_history: No obvious physical illness; has not received psychotherapy before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe thoughts and feelings; negative tone, often uses comparisons and absolute expressions, tends to focus on the negative; skeptical about change but willing to try

basic_info.main_problem: Recently I have been overly fixated on fitness and 'doing my best,' affecting my self-esteem and body image; in social media comparisons I often filter out positive feedback and focus only on the negative, causing stress and feeling overwhelmed.
basic_info.core_demands: Hopes to no longer feel forever not good enough, to reduce the suffering brought by excessive exercise and negative self-image, and to improve overall well-being.
growth_experiences: Because the client obtained a scholarship through soccer and received many compliments about their physique, pressure to 'be the best' arose; on social media (such as Instagram), the client frequently compared themselves with others, gradually disqualifying positive feedback and focusing on the negative, lowering their sense of self-worth.

core_beliefs: Only by being the best do I have value

special_situations.event: Browses others on Instagram (body shape, performance) and compares
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not the best among my peers, it equals failure and not being worthy of recognition
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increases training duration and tightens dietary control, sacrificing study and socializing to prove the self
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what I do, there is always someone better than me; my efforts do not count

special_situations.event: Receiving compliments about figure and being noticed for a soccer scholarship
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot keep maintaining or even go further, others will be disappointed; I must always perform perfectly
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Invests more time in training, strict dieting, and reduces time with friends to maintain condition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I must always stay at my best, otherwise I am worthless

special_situations.event: While studying, thinking that training progress may fall behind
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Missing even one practice session means being surpassed by others and declining form
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Prioritizes training and gives up or reduces study time
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot stop training, or I will fall behind

special_situations.event: Facing food choices (such as foods that are not so 'healthy')
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as it is not healthy enough, it will ruin my figure and waste all previous effort
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Following an extremely strict diet list, limiting variety and social eating
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is not healthy enough; it will ruin my body shape

core_conflict.wish: Longs to gain a sense of worth and the security of acceptance through being recognized and being the best
core_conflict.fear: Fearing that once I am not good enough I will be negated, lose in comparisons, and lose love and recognition
defense_goal: Maintaining external approval through control and perfectionism
Avoids shame and feelings of 'not being good enough' through excessive training and strict dieting

object_relations.self_representation: A competitor who is never enough and constantly needs to prove oneself
object_relations.object_representation: Picky others / audiences who compare at any time and may be disappointed (peers and social media)

object_relations.self_representation: A person who, once showing vulnerability, will be seen as weak
object_relations.object_representation: Friends/others who would not understand and may judge

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes identifying and challenging negative automatic thoughts and trying to change
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes these methods do not work for them and feels change is impossible (regarding hope as unrealistic)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle and empathic tone, acknowledges their doubt and hardship; invites trying in the manner of 'small-step experiments', without forcing, emphasizing adjustability at any time.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor affirms their progress and encourages evaluating oneself by internal standards
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treats the external standard 'must be the best' as the only correctness; anything less than the best is worthless
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Help distinguish the 'introjected must-be-best' voice from their own real needs; use reflection and clarification, encouraging first-person descriptions of present feelings and desires.

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats 'must be the best' as the only standard
Turns others' compliments into demands that must be continually maintained

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believing friends 'will not understand' and 'will think I am weak' and thus not expressing
On social media, presuming others will judge oneself by higher standards

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Suppressing help-seeking out of worry about seeming to complain or being weak
Constraining oneself with strict training and diet; continuous self-judgment

positive_force: Has outstanding athletic ability and self-discipline (soccer scholarship)
Able to perceive the problem and proactively seek psychological counseling help
Noticing improvement in one's own strength and health level
Has some friends who can be contacted (potential support resources)
negative_force: Self-worth highly dependent on external comparison and evaluation
Negative cognitive biases are significant (mental filtering, disqualifying the positive, fortune telling)
Core belief of 'I am not good enough / only the best has value'

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive exercise and strict dietary control (accompanied by continuous self-comparison and self-negation)
antecedent: Seeing peers' better performance or figures on Instagram
After receiving others' compliments, feels pressure to maintain
While studying, the thought 'I need to go train' surfaces
Facing food choices that are not 'healthy' enough
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizes the belief that 'only by being the best is one valuable' together with external comparison, holds catastrophic expectations about failure in physique and performance, and relieves the shame and anxiety of not being good enough by controlling training and diet
target_behavior.function: Gaining a sense of control and external recognition, temporarily reducing anxiety and self-doubt
target_behavior.consequence: Academic attention and grades declined, socializing reduced, eating and life flexibility restricted, overall well-being lowered, self-esteem damaged
